plan.notes: Source: Temple University Undergraduate Bulletin (current), 'Genomic Medicine BS with Pre-Medicine Concentration — Suggested Plan for New Students Starting in the 2026-2027 Academic Year'. 123 total credits, 8 semesters; semester sums match catalog-published term totals (17/15/15/16/14/16/15/15). The plan publishes credit ranges on elective slots (3-4, 3-2, 2-1); each range term is transcribed at the combination that sums exactly to the catalog's published term total, documented faithfully here: Year 3 Spring = Genomic Medicine elective 3 + elective 3; Year 4 Fall = GenEd 3 + elective 2; Year 4 Spring = Genomic Medicine elective 3 + elective 3. Prerequisite ordering verified: BIOL 1111 before BIOL 1112/2112 before BIOL 2207; MATH 1041 before MATH 1042; CHEM 1031 before CHEM 1032 before CHEM 2201 before CHEM 2202; PHYS 1021 before PHYS 1022.
